description: Arranges content in a grid that adapts to the available width.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between grid cells. When absent, uses the --tp-grid-gap CSS default.

attributes.name: min-width
attributes.description: Minimum column width used by the responsive grid template, limited to the available container width. When absent, uses the --tp-grid-min-width CSS default.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-grid>` element arranges content in a grid that adapts to the available width.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Reading | This component organizes or presents content. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Component itself | No dedicated keyboard action. |
| Embedded controls, when present | Use their normal keyboard interactions. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
